[IDAT.3.3.6] **Miss semantics.** `ds_json_array_at` (index out of
range) and `ds_json_object_get` (key absent) return
`DS_ERR_NOT_FOUND` with `*out = NULL`: a miss is exceptional for a
direct lookup. This is deliberately distinct from `ds_json_get_path`,
whose path-miss is lenient — `DS_OK` with `*out = NULL`.

A read writes its out-parameters on success and on these misses, and
nowhere else. After any other error status the caller **must not** read
an out-parameter.
